verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a real public API: a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at app.puzzle.io/rest/v0, a ReadMe-hosted reference with a per-endpoint Try It console, and a separate sandbox server. However, access is request-gated by email, sandbox credentials are provisioned manually, the API is v0 and "under development," and the vendor says it was built for platform-to-platform integrations, so it is unclear whether an individual user can drive their own account through it. Missing for 10: self-serve API access and credentials, evidence the API serves individual end users rather than embedding platforms, a changelog or deprecation policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
